name: joblet-audit
description: Joblet PR/code-review system. Multi-agent (Checker -> Cynic -> Researcher-on-demand) review of a git diff or pasted code/SQL/config against Joblet's own audit history + load-test-calibrated thresholds, with a deterministic static pre-pass. Read-only, no API key. Commands: /joblet-audit:Joblet-review (everyday), :34287 (weekly report), :35398/:46408 (approver-gated), :456098 (source-gated, Soham).
